Mike / Steph — I ran a quick analysis and wrote up the trade-offs. Short summary:
- 25% list discount on hosted usage at their forecast (~450M tokens/mo) reduces gross margin on that workload by ~18 percentage points at current cost structure.
- With default caching/batching profiles we can keep latency SLOs but marginal infra cost still goes up; runway is ok for a 12-month pilot.

Recommended commercial guardrails before asking execs to sign off:
1) 12-month committed term with minimum monthly usage floor (300M tokens/mo) or 50% of forecast in month 1-3 ramp.
2) Upfront 3-month prepay or 30-day non-refundable deposit to cover first-quarter infra delta.
3) Auto-review at month 9 to re-price if actual consumption exceeds forecast by >30%.
4) Include standard Hosted API SLA addendum and require acceptance (we can attach).

If those are acceptable we can recommend exec approval for a one-time 25% concession to land the strategic pilot. I've attached the cost impact sheet (numbers highlighted).

Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk
